description: This file defines the 'Home' component for the Recipe Explorer web application using LightningJS. It sets up the component structure, including child components for header, search bar, recipe grid, and recipe detail, and manages state, computed properties, and methods for user interactions.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: LightningJS component representing the homepage of the Recipe Explorer app, managing recipe display, search, and detail view.

methods.name: onQuery
methods.description: Handles changes in the search query input by updating the store's query state.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a recipe, updating the store to display detailed information.

methods.name: onCloseDetail
methods.description: Closes the recipe detail view by updating the store.

methods.name: onBackFromSearch
methods.description: Handles back navigation, closing detail if open or navigating back through the router.
